title: Planes flying over the Atlantic will be re-routed to avoid contrails | New Scientist
description: Operation Blue Skies is the world’s first trial to deploy contrail avoidance measures across an entire airspace, aiming to lower the climate impact of flights on a large scale
author: Madeleine Cuff

title: Physicists may have solved a 30-year mystery over missing neutrinos | New Scientist
description: Since the 1990s, researchers have wondered if unexpected results from gallium-based neutrino detectors are a sign of a new kind of particle, but a new study suggests that revising their calculations could explain the anomaly
author: Karmela Padavic-Callaghan

title: Britain's only desalination plant remains idle during drought | New Scientist
description: Water flow in the river Thames has dropped low enough to warrant the use of England’s only large-scale desalination plant, but it hasn’t been switched on at all this year
author: Madeleine Cuff

title: Our blood's body clock may be causing anaemia cases to be missed | New Scientist
description: Blood tests may give different results depending on when in the day, or the year, they are taken, which could result in people missing out on an anaemia diagnosis
author: Linda Geddes

title: Weightlifting makes older women leaner, stronger and more mobile | New Scientist
description: Lifting at least 50 kilograms twice a week improved older women's muscle mass, mobility and balance
author: Alice Klein

title: Quantum computing may be facing a replication crisis | New Scientist
description: A review of thousands of scientific papers about quantum computers finds that most don’t provide code that can be tested on independent devices or that the code doesn’t work
author: Karmela Padavic-Callaghan
